hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq '(^|[;&|(])[[:space:]]*find([[:space:]]+-[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*)*[[:space:]]+/([[:space:]]|$)'; then echo 'Blocked: find rooted at bare / scans the entire filesystem and can trigger macOS TCC permission prompts (Photos, Music, etc.) by walking into protected library folders. Scope the search to a real path, for example: find . -name pattern, or find /specific/path -name pattern.' >&2; exit 2; fi
